# Find rows where column 0 starts with PRG-
prog_rows = []
for i, row in df_raw.iterrows():
    val = row[0]
    if isinstance(val, str) and val.startswith('PRG-'):
        prog_rows.append(i)
print("Programme rows indices:", prog_rows)
print("Number of programme rows:", len(prog_rows))
# Print all programme rows
for i in prog_rows:
    print(i, df_raw.iloc[i,0], df_raw.iloc[i,4:10].tolist())
